title: How to Stamp Foil on Kraft Paper and Rough Paper

seo.title: How to Stamp Foil on Kraft Paper and Rough Paper

content:
Rough paper packaging needs a different hot stamping foil approach from smooth coated paper.

## Main Point

The surface is uneven, so foil brightness and coverage may be less consistent. Use the real paper sample for approval before production.

## FAQ

### Can rough paper be foil stamped?

Yes, but the result often keeps some of the paper texture.

## Sample Support

Send your paper sample for foil recommendation.
